items: 【Black Floor Lamp with Modern Design】 - Our floor lamp design style is simple and modern, and can match different styles of furniture you want. Tall lamp will transform your home decor into a rustic and farmhouse atmosphere. Black standing lamp fits perfectly in your living room, bedroom, corner or office and takes up very little room and has a classy, retro look to it. Floor lamps for living room bright lighting both blends in and provides unassuming accent to the space.

【Replaceable LED Bulb】- The modern floor lamp with 3000K/6W LED bulbs provides warm white light to create a comfortable atmosphere for your home. It's also brighter than those ordinary lamps and can light up a larger space in your home. This light bulb is replaceable and can be changed to the type you want according to your preferences. We have already provided you with a ST58 bulb, so you don't need to buy any more.

【Heavy Base, Safe to Use】- Industrial floor lamp has a highly stable base and light pole and can stand firmly on the floor, which prevents the elderly, children and pets from being overturned. With the height of 64.6 inch, The standing light is equipped with a rust-resistant black metal body and a sturdy clear glass shade, which makes it look gorgeous and expensive. Based on the moderate weight of pole lamp, you can easily place it anywhere you want.

【Foot Pedal Switch, Liberate Your Hands】- In order to bring more convenience to your life, we specially chose the foot switch design for floor lamp. The on/off switch is a push button that sits on the floor so you could press it with your foot easily. With the simple flick of a switch, you can get lighting or not. Easy to operate, greatly liberate your hands!

【Easy to Assemble】 - This living room lamp can be easily assembled without tools, as all the detachable components are included in the package. In just a few minutes, you can follow the instructions to put all parts of the tall lamp together. Instructions are included in the package, and assembly videos are attached to the product page.
